scheme_name: Kerala Stressed MSMEs Revival & Rehabilitation Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a manufacturing MSME established in Kerala.
Must not belong to the Negative List of prohibited units.
Must be classified as a Sick Unit and be Potentially Viable for revival.
Must be an independent legal entity.
Must restart operations within one month of receiving assistance and continue for at least five years.
Must provide true information and cooperate with Vyavasaya Mithra.
Units sick due to willful mismanagement, default, unauthorized fund diversion, or partner disputes are ineligible.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹5 lakh per unit as a one‑time assistance covering margin‑money grant, interest subvention, restart expenses, statutory dues clearance and revival project report cost reimbursement.
